shots.note: wide establishing of the cold side chamber, slow pan right: Haon enters screen left with the ember, passes a lying skeleton, stops and notices something on the floor
insert, floor level: an old sword lies beside a slumped dead skeleton; Haon's feet step into frame
medium side shot: Haon bends and grips the sword with her right hand, ember kept in the left, and rises with it
front three-quarter on Haon examining the blade; behind her, out of focus in the gloom, the skeleton she passed rises (she does not see it), then she hears it
medium two-shot from the side, slight handheld: Haon turns to face the skeleton and raises the sword to guard; it walks at her
close, handheld shake: the skeleton chops down, Haon sidesteps out of the blow
low angle looking up: Haon steps in, sword overhead, and slashes down; the skeleton is hit (impact shake)
wide: the skeleton crumbles to the floor; Haon stands over it, breathing hard
close on Haon: she catches her breath, lowers the sword, then turns her head toward the far doorway
over her right shoulder toward the dark doorway in the far wall, cold light beyond it
wide, slow pan: Haon walks away screen right, sword lowered in the right hand, ember in the left, out through the far doorway

markers.label: Haon enters screen left, ember glowing in her left hand
she notices the sword on the floor
right hand grips the old sword
behind her the skeleton she passed starts to rise
the skeleton lunges and chops where she stood (she sidestepped)
the skeleton collapses into a heap of bones
she looks to the far doorway
she walks out through the far doorway
